title: Figure 1: Utility of KE and HEL weapons by target type and laser power
description: Comparison chart titled "HEL and Kinetic Weapons offer complementary capabilities" listing target types in four columns (Soft/Small/Fast, Moving/tactical, Missiles & Satellites, Hardened or Large Area) with examples such as UAVs, vehicles, ICBMs and buildings. A laser power axis from 1 kW to 1 MW shows laser weapon effectiveness ranging from Easy to Impractical, contrasted with kinetic-energy weapon effectiveness from Impractical to Easy. Caption reads "Figure 1. Utility of KE and HEL Weapons."
